title: The Briarwood Hunter's Almanac
author: Wat Fennimore, woodsman
notes: Extra shelf book: Briarwood lore (3.5): wolves, the Sleepers' Path, the Standing Horn; Horn-role source in a hunter's idiom.

pages.text:
Wolves run the north bank from autumn. Mind the wind, and carry fire.

There is a line of trampled ferns in the wood that you will see only at night or if you have a sharp eye. I have followed it twice. Both times I turned back at the fifth tree and could not tell you why.

The Standing Horn in the clearing is Hornfolk work, a tall grey stone with a figure cut into it and its hands over its ears. Hunters touch it for luck. I do. There is something big, and old, and patient in these woods that wants no harm to come to anything, and I would sooner it thought well of me.
